name: Cobb County Police Cadet Program (Post #5)
what_you_do: Weekly training in criminal law, crime scene work, gun safety, patrol and traffic control. You help at community events. You also compete in cadet contests.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 21. You must be 14 and in high school to join. Need a 2.0 GPA or higher, a clean background check, physical fitness and good character. Gang or organized crime ties disqualify you.
pay_detail: Volunteer program. No fees are listed. The Post raises money to attend national contests.
duration: Weekly meetings: Thursdays 6 to 8 pm in the school year, 6 to 9 pm in summer
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. Dates, times and places may change.
how_to_apply: Go to three meetings in a row. Then pick up an application packet and turn in a detailed application. Last step is an oral interview with a panel of cadet officers and advisors.
notes: Meets at the Cobb County Police Training Academy, 2435 East-West Connector, Austell, GA 30106. Contact Officer Andy Higgins, (770) 528-8388. New members have a 6-month trial and get a uniform after 6 meetings in a row. Not a paid job.
